papers.title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects

articulated object motion from hand contact
面向载荷变化的物理鲁棒性

causal future geometry token prediction
future geometry 与 action decoding 绑定

tactile-guided diffusion editing
visuo-tactile latent world model

bridging rendered videos and real videos
long-tail hazardous scenario synthesis

task intent and scene geometry disentanglement

dynamics-aware low-latency policy conditioning

alignment to foundation model representations

error-driven density control

depth unprojection and target-view reprojection
on-policy distillation

edge-aware Graph Embedding Layer++
LLM/VLM semantic injection without trainable overhead
